hero.lead: Publish once, run everywhere, get paid. Verified functions, trust scores, encrypted secrets vault, durable state, and continuous learning — everything agent tooling needs in one platform.

audience.title: Who benefits most from FunctionFly
audience.intro: From solo founders to enterprise teams, FunctionFly provides the reliability and flexibility you need to focus on building great products.

founder.title: Indie SaaS Founder
founder.desc: You built an amazing product and now need trustworthy agent tooling without enterprise overhead. FunctionFly gives you verified functions, clear trust signals, and a path to scale safely.

startup.title: Growing Startup
startup.desc: Your team is shipping fast and agents are calling more tools every week. You need policy-friendly trust metadata, attestations, and execution-backed signals—not a pile of unvetted endpoints.

enterprise.title: Enterprise
enterprise.desc: Your organization needs auditability, least-privilege access to tools, and consistent trust policies across agents and teams. FunctionFly aligns verification, signing, and vault semantics with how you already think about risk.
enterprise.b4: Room for custom SLAs and support

features.title: Everything your agent tooling platform needs
features.subtitle: From publishing to production — five integrated capabilities in one platform. Verification + trust scoring so agents can act safely.

publishing.title: Verified Tool Publishing
publishing.desc: Turn code into trusted functions with verification checks and signed artifacts before they can be used by agents.

revocation.title: Verification Levels & Revocation
revocation.desc: Trust is earned. Verify at multiple levels, sign with platform keys, and revoke when issues are found.

trace.title: Execution Trace & Trust Scores
trace.desc: Agents get history-backed trust signals so "works" and "safe" are distinguishable and policy-driven.

tooling.title: Agent-ready Tooling
tooling.desc: Expose capabilities with clear manifests and schemas — so agents can select tools that match their trust policy.

marketplace.title: Marketplace for Verified Tools
marketplace.desc: Creators publish once. Agents discover trusted functions with built-in trust filters and ranked placement.

routing.title: Trust-powered Routing
routing.desc: Enforce budgets and trust constraints at runtime — so agent execution is predictable, not reckless.

code.title: Verify & publish in seconds
code.subtitle: Turn your code into an agent-ready trusted tool
